name: Kōnan (Saitama, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kōnan town emblem in red: a winged device of horizontal strokes with a stylised character, like a torii.
history: Flag of the former town of Kōnan in Saitama Prefecture, dissolved on 2007-02-13.

features.role: Kōnan town emblem — a winged device of horizontal strokes with a stylised character, like a torii
